type Tree = Tree[];
const bad: Tree = [[1]];
type Direct = Direct;
type InUnion = InUnion | number;
type InRecord = Record<string, InRecord>;
type InPartial = Partial<InPartial>;
type KeyOfArray = keyof KeyOfArray[];
type ElementOfArray = ElementOfArray[][number];
type LengthOfArray = LengthOfArray[]["length"];
type FirstOfTuple = [FirstOfTuple][0];
type CheckedArray = CheckedArray[] extends unknown[] ? 1 : 2;
type MappedArray = Partial<MappedArray[]>;
